Take care. Look out for yourself.
Isn't it nice how the sun is always shining?
I like this place. Almost feels like home now.
I admit I was angry when they threw me out. "Unstable mind." Fucking pussies.
For getting thrown out. What did you do?
Alright. You don't have to tell me.
Nothing. It was due to medical reasons.
I think it's better if you keep some distance now.
Never met him personally. But the Oracle is well known to me.
How was your meeting with the Oracle?
Sounds like he's in danger. He wanted me to get him out of there.
He said someone is searching for him.
I don't know. The Oracle wasn't very coherent.
So where is the Oracle now? Did you get him out of there?
No. It's... I didn't really meet him physically. I think.
He was in some cave, but I reached out to him by communicating through the flesh.
Wait! It was you who reached out first and not the other way around?
I do. We should clarify this later when we have more time.
For now we have to deal with the Oracle being in danger.
He is one of the Titans. We need to protect him, **forename** of the Flesh.
Fuck that! You made me believe you were someone who cared.
You were curious enough to let your fate guide you here. And interested enough so that you told me about the Oracle.
You want to walk away from this now?
Yes. I don't want to help.
Then leave my home. And don't return.
Good. I'm glad that you changed your mind.
First we'll have to find the Oracle.
The Philosopher is an old friend of mine and knows many of the other Titans. We should ask him.
Journey straight to the east from here, **forename** of the Flesh, and visit the Philosopher.
You might also ask him about your communication with the flesh.
I'll try to contact another friend in the meantime.
Ok. I'll travel to the Philosopher.
Fine. Let's meet again here afterwards.
Don't let the waste skin you.
Actually, I met the Philosopher already.
Dead? Holy flesh. This can't be.
But I found this recording. Extracted from the machine the Philosopher was connected to.
This works as a world config container. We could build a Cyberwomb module from that to experience the recording.
Hand it over to the Master Processor over there.
It's good that we're doing this together.
Tell me about this, **forename** of the Flesh.
I'm not sure what sickness this is. Feels like my organs are in turmoil.
I have to puke a lot.
This sickness I know. But I'm no traditional healer.
There's a doctor in Tauris if you need one.
I've been to the doctor. Wasn't much help.
Then I talked to Mortus. He's investigating the Flesh Nexus.
By the Titans! How did you get in?
I commanded the flesh to let me in.
You reek of the flesh. You speak true.
You have your task. See you later.
I created the Cyberwomb Module of the recording.
That's good to hear, **forename** of the Flesh. Let's take a look at it. Together.
I wonder what we'll encounter. You've been to a Cyberwomb before?
I spent most of my life in Omniwomb.
Hand it over to the Master Processor.
I told you to leave my home. This is your last warning. Leave, NOW!
Enough is enough. This is your death.
Yes, I have. I found him in New Delphi.
I visited his mind. Unfortunately the Feeder had been there already.
In the mind of the Oracle?
He was a mess. What he said wasn't very coherent.
According to him the Feeder is in search of the Wormwound.
Do you know what that is?
Not really. But it's connected to the flesh. The Oracle called it the origin.
I never heard about this before.
**forename** of the Flesh, this is exciting.
Yes, it's very exciting. Could be devastating and dangerous, too, no?
I smell your excitement, too. You and me, we're of the same flesh.
He said north. Somewhere north. And that the Perished City might hold answers.
But the Perished City is closed. I've never been there.
He mentioned there might be a path through the mountains.
Good. ... Then I suggest you go looking for that path and try to get into the city.
Please contact me when you found out where this Wormwound is.
You have to find the Oracle before the Feeder does.
Our best bet of discovering the Oracle is to ask around at a busy place.
Travel south to the Puke Bar and ask around there.
Oh, and I know there's a Cyberwomb in the Puke Bar, too.
You'll find a power module for it in the underground here in Old Trees.
And I'll give you this virtual representation of Old Trees, and we use this as a meeting point.
The Cyberwombs in the Puke Bar and the one here in Old Trees are connected.
It's been a while since I was here.
This is a Cyberwomb of the Philosopher's Lair.
A near as possible representation, I guess.
Our bodies are safe while we're in here, right?
It's a full virtual sensory experience like the Omniwomb. Nothing happens to your real bodies.
So what do we do here?
We're examining the remnants of the Philosopher. Let's explore.
Let's return to the physical world.
This I know: The Feeder is here in the city. Or was. It worries me.
The worms told me about the wandering Titan. And how he visited the Villa.
Changes lie ahead. And grave danger, for all of the Flesh.
At least Morrowmeat is alive still. I was glad to see this.
Do you still think that the Feeder is dangerous?
Yes, I truly think he is.
The Feeder threatens what is most precious to me: The lives and the souls of the Titans.
I do not see clearly what he plans to do. But I fear that it cannot be good. Not for the Titans, and not for us, their protectors.
I became a Worm Shaman because I care, and I won't stop caring.
You should be careful how you spend your time here on Nexus.
The worms will be watching you.
What do you think of Morrowmeat?
Eh, I don't think he's so bad.
No. This city I mean. This graveyard built from stone and ashes.
Morrowmeat is sick. He's suffering. But still he is exploited to provide meat.
This is not how it should be. The Titans and their profound souls should nurture our souls. They should enrich us.
I have the means to enter the Temple.
Then enter and talk to Mother. Meet her with respect.
And do not mention my name.
Mother and I had a difference of opinion.
It should not trouble you. Just don't talk to her about it.
By the Titans, **forename** of the Flesh.
It is good to see you still being alive.
It's been a while since I've been here in the Perished City.
I wanted to visit one of my old friends.
But I couldn't. I won't. She wouldn't be happy to see me.
Yes, **forename** of the Flesh. It's her temple. It's Mother's temple.
Did you get into the city?
{The animal is large and bulky. It seems to be friendly in nature.}
{The animal is experiencing a lot of stress currently.}
{You are successful in calming the animal.}
Hmmh. Still a flesh thingy with a big eye.
I think it's a flesh thingy with a big eye.
The maggots are still there, I guess?
Yes. they're back there in the cellar, where we keep our meat.
Very good. Could you take care of the maggots then, please?
I'm done with the Flesh Maggots.
The guests were already beginning to wonder why the meat started to taste differently.
Here, take this as a thank you.
Actually, yes. We got a little pest problem.
But since you're asking, wanna help us out with that?
Ok then. I guess it was too much to hope to have a helping hand here.
You see, flesh maggots have made their nest inside the bar's meat reserves.
And to get rid of 'em we need something potent.
Eh... Is that the meat you're serving here?
Like I said, we need something potent against flesh maggots.
But we ran out of poison.
There's a doctor up in Tauris. He sold us the last batch. Try it over there.
I heard the doctor is dead.
What? Ohh, fuck me. What a miserable world.
I have to make do without the poison then. Thanks for letting me know.
So this is the Puke Bar...
Always. There are travelers stopping by here.
Drinks and food are good. Obviously.
We have a Cyberwomb room that may or may not be functional.
And the Bar is old enough that it has some secrets I can't tell you about.
Do you know where I can find the Oracle?
But if you're religious or something like that you should probably head east towards New Delphi.
Occasionally pilgrims are making a stop here and trying to convert me, haha.
What do you need? Booze? Meat? Something else?
Looks like this machine is connected to the gate.
But the gate is open now. I don't need this anymore.
Yeah, looks like this is gonna work.
But, since you've been there already, I guess I feel comfortable having you around again.
Good. I'll be here, waiting for you.
Then stay calm and embrace my thoughts...
Thank you for caring about me.
It's all fractured still. And hazy.
But, finally, I feel like myself again. I am seeing again. I am a master of my own mind again.
You were not the master of your own mind?
No. He caught up to me. He found me.
This is what I had feared. This is why I had asked for help.
The Feeder reached me, and not only that, but he chained me, manipulated me, brainwashed me.
He was the master of my mind.
He's in search of the Wormwound.
The origin. The flesh. I don't really know. I feel it as a presence, but I don't know what it is.
It's connected to the Flesh Nexus. As am I.
I have an infection. I feel like I'm connected to the flesh, too.
I know you have a connection. I wouldn't have reached you over that distance, otherwise.
Now that my mind isn't that fuzzy anymore... Are you really a worm shaman?
Hmmh. Well, that's a pity. But I guess you helped me nonetheless.
You think this Wormwound might give me answers about my infection? Or heal me from it?
I... honestly don't know. I'm sure you'll find answers when finding the Wormwound, but I don't know what kind of answers those will be.
I don't know. The Feeder questioned me. Painfully.
The agony. The sweet, sweet agony.
But I couldn't tell. Because I don't know.
I feel that it's up north from here. And that's what he felt from me, too.
The Perished City will have the answers. It has to.
How do I get to the Perished City?
Last I heard, the city is closed. But I listened to many travelers throughout the years. Some of them found a path through the mountains.
The Feeder. If the Feeder is interested in the Wormwound, and searching for it, then this does not bode well.
Oh. This makes me sad to hear.
He's dangerous and up to no good. So if you would wander north, in the search of the Wormwound, please be careful.
That is good to hear. It's good to know there are still people around taking care about the Flesh Titans.
You touch me. You embrace me.
You open your mind, and then I let you in, and you see what's wrong, what's messed up.
You'll fix it. You fix my mind. You're a worm shaman from the wasteland.
I will have to think about this.
Worm shaman. You’ve heard my call. You are here to rescue me.
A great deal of responsibility rests on your shoulders, this I can tell.
But is it too late? Or is there a sense of hope we can latch on to?
Who’s speaking here? Be quiet. ... BE QUIET!
He told me you would come. But I already knew that you would come.
I suppose he can foretell, too?
Not that I can. Nobody can.
You have to help me. This is all too much. The memories... I cannot silence them anymore. You have to help me.
Speak! The Oracle awaits your words.
I want to leave this place now.
I won't hold you back anymore.
THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
The rules. I cannot abide the rules. ... Do you know the rules?
Then don't ask me about them.
No, you do not know. I can feel it. I can read it.
I... this is strange. I can sense that you're speaking the truth.
You're not the Feeder. You're not me. Who are you?
I am still myself. In your mind.
Yes. But I think they are guidelines, not rules.
The Feeder told me to strictly follow the rules.
He is wrong. You're an Oracle. You interpret. You guide. You don't follow rules.
You don't have to listen to all voices all the time.
You talk to some. Not all of them.
Ok. I'll let your mind go now.
I feel better now. You should leave my mind so we can talk in the real world.
Welcome to my domain. I am the all-seeing mind. I watch and guide all living beings that approach me.
But who can last an eternity? What strength does the all-seeing mind have against the tides of time?
A crack, a fracture, widening due to neglect, and being worn out by the steady rhythm of incoming guests.
What is the purpose of those who approach me? Do they want to see the world like I do?
Or do they want to be told that there is nothing further to be seen?
Do they need reassurance, and their fear taken away, or are they ready to see more possibilities?
We are nowhere. We are everywhere at once. We are inside my mind, and this mind is endless.
Your body remains in that cave.
THERE IS NO GOING BACK! We are together now.
The rules! I forgot about the rules again.
I imposed my will on those seeking guidance. I created fate instead of showing it.
The Feeder said to follow the rules.
The rules? Are those to be followed?
They're here. In my mind. Take a look.
I am the Guidance of Thoughts.
I am the Voice of Nexus.
I can sense you're afar. But you're on Nexus. You're part of our Nexus.
How do you know my name?
I can feel his pulse. He's in search of me.
You have to get me out of here before he finds me.
How would I get you out of here?
One move and I'll shoot you, straight in your noggin'.
Just where the hell are you?
You! Don't scare me like that!
I must be goin' crazy down 'ere.
Ripped 'em straight outta the sockets. Up an' away they were.
What do they want with your eyes?
I've been stuck down 'ere ever since.
Lead me to 'em an' I'll make it worth your time.
Hey! Don't you dare leavin' me alone down here.
We gotta lock the exits first, so those bastards can't escape.
I fell over a lever somewhere nearby a couple of days ago.
I'm followin' the sound of your steps.
Now let me have 'em. I'll give you somethin' in return too.
I just heard you walkin' away, didn't I.
Tryin' to sneak off with my eyes, are you?
Great. Now let me put 'em back in.
Ah yes. I can see again.
You look worse than I imagined.
But I did offer you somethin' in return, didn't I? Here, take this.
Ok. Goodbye then. Takin' a rest first.
We gotta lock the exits first, so those bastards can't escape.
I fell over a lever somewhere nearby a couple of days ago.
One of 'em bots upstairs still gotta carry 'em.
Just kill everything that moves - gotta find 'em somehow.
Could you take out your gun again?
I need you to be ready, just in case.
So you finally came back to your senses. Good.
You crazy? 'ave them bots taken your brain now?
Just trust me on this one.
If you say so. But I hear just a beep of somethin' not bein' right, and I'll get it out again.
Could you stay here for a while?
I'll go check out the area ahead.
And then you run away with the eyes?
No way. I know your type.
I trust you no further than the length of my barrel.
I just heard you walkin' away, didn't I.
Tryin' to sneak off with my eyes, are you?

Ah yes. I can see again.

Now that I can see again, it sure looks bleak around 'ere.
Don't think I'm useless just cause my eyes are missing.
When I can see again, imma get the best piece of meat I can find.
What did the bots take away from me again?
Oh right, my eyes. Still can't see shit.
Is that a wall in front of me?
Don't wait for me. I can smell where you are from all over.
I may be blind, but I sure like the atmosphere.
Try bein' less loud. Them bots will immediately know where we are.
Blind Man, can you help me with that?
Ready to go? I'll follow your smell.
I'm sure I'll get to hear lots of stories once my friend is back.
Thank you for being such an honest person.
May the Titans bless your heart.
A friend of mine recently decided to travel around more.
He's gone to a place called "Mine 19" to the west of here.
I don't know what you've done.
But you have to leave now.
The world is a dangerous place.
Thank you for being honest with me.
Somebody must have gutted the insides.
There's a trap door hidden under the bed.
How can I help you today?
Can you tell me a bit about the city?
Yes. I am honored to be of help to you.
The Crystal City was founded by humans, supported by machines.
During the Bleeding the Crystal City experienced great duress and hostile invaders.
The city was at the brink of perishing, but the machines—that is us, by the way—came through and defended it.
Due to their benevolence, the machines allowed a peaceful co-existence with the Flesh Titans.
A few of the humans transgressed into religious absurdity focused on the Flesh Titans, but the machines kept a clear head.
What followed was a long phase of truce and of acclimating with new complex cultural circumstances.
This era lasted until the truce was broken.
The truce was broken by the treachery of the Flesh. A pernicious campaign of violence, led by the Titans, that cost many lives, mostly human, and could only be overcome with an iron fist.
To prevent further danger from the city the Machine Law was established and the machines—that is still us, by the way—took over full control.
What followed, until and including today, was an era of security and prosperity.
Here, let me show it to you.
Welcome to the Administration of the Crystal City.
How can I be of help to you today, citizen?
[Send bait command to trigger a security response.]

It is through my infrastructure that the city is governed.
I am also responsible for receiving submissions by our citizens.
Inquiries, pleadings, reviews, notifications and others.
Can I take a look at the citizen submissions?
Yes, as a citizen of the Crystal City you are allowed to have a look at them.
What's with the gaps between the submission numbers?

I have this dangerous software virus here. Would you like to have it?
Yes. Give it to us and we compensate you with a full access pass to the city.
